description: Evaluation questions for the NovaTech sample documents. Every expected fact is a literal phrase of the named document (checked by tests).

cases.question: How many days of paid annual leave does a full-time employee get?
cases.ground_truth: A full-time employee receives 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

cases.question: How many unused leave days can be carried forward to the next year?
expected_facts: Up to 10 unused days can be carried forward
cases.ground_truth: Up to 10 unused days can be carried forward to the next year.

cases.question: When is a medical certificate required for sick leave?
expected_facts: if sick leave lasts more than 2 consecutive days
cases.ground_truth: A medical certificate is required if sick leave lasts more than 2 consecutive days.

cases.question: How long is maternity leave?
expected_facts: Maternity leave is 26 weeks of paid leave
cases.ground_truth: Maternity leave is 26 weeks of paid leave.

cases.question: How long must a password be and how often must it be changed?
cases.ground_truth: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and changed every 180 days.

cases.question: Within what time must a security incident be reported?
cases.ground_truth: A suspected security incident must be reported to security@novatech.example within 1 hour.

cases.question: How much does the NovaDesk Business plan cost?
expected_facts: Business plan costs USD 39 per agent per month
cases.ground_truth: The Business plan costs USD 39 per agent per month.

cases.question: How long is the NovaDesk free trial?
cases.ground_truth: All NovaDesk plans include a free trial of 21 days.

cases.question: What is the API rate limit on the NovaDesk Starter plan?
expected_facts: 100 requests per minute on the Starter plan
cases.ground_truth: The API rate limit is 100 requests per minute on the Starter plan.

cases.question: What is the daily meal allowance during domestic travel?
expected_facts: daily meal allowance during domestic travel is INR 1,200
cases.ground_truth: The daily meal allowance during domestic travel is INR 1,200.

cases.question: Within how many days must expense claims be submitted?
expected_facts: within 30 days of the expense date
cases.ground_truth: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense date.

cases.question: How long is the probation period for new employees?
What is the yearly learning budget per employee?
cases.ground_truth: Every employee gets a learning budget of INR 30,000 per year.

cases.question: What must employees use to connect to internal systems when working outside the office?
cases.ground_truth: Employees must connect through NovaVPN before opening any internal system.
